comparison.objective: Discharge a capacitor before removing and boxing a power-supply board.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a two-pin electrical tool on two pads, then extract and transfer a board.
comparison.success_condition: Maintain two-pad contact for two seconds before board removal; numeric extraction tolerances and damage rules are not given.
comparison.reason: The defining ability is safety-ordered sustained electrical contact followed by board extraction, not impact fracture and containment of four fragments.
